name: Nori
source:
Nori is the owner of the Black Market in Cemetery and sometimes, he manages the arena. He hates small talk and puts business before anything. To him, money is the most important!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
